FIRECalculatorHQ shows you the one number that changes that: the exact amount you need invested so your money covers your expenses for good — and how many years until work becomes optional. Covers Standard, Coast, Barista, Lean and Fat FIRE plus a safe-withdrawal-rate tool. Free, runs in the browser, no account.

records.name: Notevio
records.tagline: Hopefully create a new big app/ site to help students.
records.description: Upload lectures and PDFs. AI builds flashcards, MCQs, high-yield facts, and mnemonics — with adaptive learning that targets your weak spots.

records.name: Lockscape — Wallpaper Gallery
records.tagline: Find a wallpaper that makes your lock screen feel yours
records.description: Lockscape is a beautifully simple wallpaper gallery for iOS. Explore more than 2,900 wallpapers, preview them full-screen, pinch to zoom, save your favorites, and download the perfect one to Photos, without creating an account. Lockscape is free to use with ads, with an optional one-time purchase to remove them forever. No subscriptions, no complicated onboarding, just great wallpapers in a fast and polished experience.

records.name: LaunchDock
records.tagline: Track referrals, sales, engagement, bots, and IP risk.
records.description: LaunchDock Track delivers referring domains, email-link attribution, engagement metrics, verified sales, bot filtering, and IP-risk signals. A FiveToClose product.

records.name: Digital Brand Calendar · Zeno
records.tagline: Free weekly social calendar for founders
records.description: Interactive social calendar for X, LinkedIn, and Reddit Maintenance, Normal, or AggrA free interactive calendar that turns brand growth into a weekly ops board Pick your platforms and pace (L1–L3). Get timed blocks for research, replies, posts, threads, networking, and review scheduled for audience peak windows but displayed in your timezone. Includes a timing guide + knowledge base from a full Digital Brand SOP. No account required.essive pace for the AI Systems Builder.

records.name: Pik Finder
records.tagline: Free media search, design studio & document generator
records.description: PikFinder searches free photos, videos and icons across Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Openverse and Wikimedia at once — then lets you design them in a free Studio, edit PDFs, and auto-generate documents (certificates, invoices) from a spreadsheet or Zoho. No signup, no watermark.

records.name: Noon
records.tagline: AI recruiting agent that sources, screens, and reaches out
records.description: Noon is an autonomous AI recruiting agent that sources, screens, and reaches out to qualified candidates — so your team can focus on hiring the best.

records.name: Paywint Digital Wallet
records.tagline: Store and use money securely with a Digital Wallet
records.description: Paywint Digital Wallet lets individuals and businesses store funds, send and receive money instantly and manage payments securely from one platform. Link bank accounts, fund your wallet, track every transaction in real time and enjoy fast, seamless transfers with a simple, intuitive experience. Built for secure, everyday payments and efficient money management.

records.name: WhyIsMyBody
records.tagline: Calm, plain-English explanations for weird body symptoms
records.description: WhyIsMyBody is a free tool that gives calm, plain-English explanations for common (and weird) body symptoms — things like eye twitching, tongue discoloration, or period changes. Instead of spiraling through scary search results, you get a simple, reassuring explanation of what's likely going on and when it's worth seeing a doctor. Built solo with Astro, Supabase, and Gemini.

records.name: VetVisit AI
records.tagline: AI veterinary scribe for faster, better medical records
records.description: VetVisit AI listens during veterinary consultations and turns them into structured SOAP notes, dental records, surgical reports, and client discharge instructions in seconds. Choose from 29 templates or create your own, then copy the note into any PIMS.

records.name: Vivaaa!
records.tagline: The easiest RSVP you and your guests will ever use
records.description: Create online invitations, collect RSVPs, and track guest confirmations with a simple RSVP app for birthdays, parties, and events. No login, emails or phone number required from your guests, and no stress for you. Just fun.

records.name: Exarbi
records.tagline: Live crypto arbitrage signals with risk context
records.description: Exarbi monitors price differences across global crypto exchanges and turns them into clear, risk-aware arbitrage signals. See transfer readiness, network status, fee impact, data freshness, confidence levels, and alternative routes in one dashboard—without connecting API keys, placing trades, or handing over custody of your funds.

records.name: BandUp IELTS: AI Speaking Test
records.tagline: Your AI IELTS speaking examiner, in your pocket
records.description: AI-powered IELTS speaking practice. Take realistic mock exams and get an estimated band score with per-criterion feedback.

records.name: MarketIQ
records.tagline: Turn recruiting into a system, not a guessing game
records.description: MarketIQ helps students break into finance, consulting, and tech by turning recruiting into a system instead of a guessing game. It tracks opportunities, surfaces the signals that actually matter, and shows you exactly what to do next. No more scattered spreadsheets or cold DMs into the void. I built this after going through IB recruiting myself. Now other students use it to run their search like an operator, not a bystander.

records.name: The new Firecrawl /search
records.tagline: Our most accurate Search API for AI agents.
records.description: Search is how AI agents ground themselves in the web, but reading full pages for every query burns tokens fast. We trained a model that returns the excerpts from each /search result that best answer your query, giving your AI agents highly relevant context from every page. It outperforms processing full pages while using 10x fewer tokens. On SimpleQA, AI agents using Firecrawl /search now score 94.7%, higher than any other provider. It's live today on every /search call.

records.name: HuntAI
records.tagline: Discover AI Tools Ranked by Real Traffic
records.description: Discover the best AI tools ranked by real SimilarWeb traffic data. Compare AI products by monthly visits, global ranking, and traffic trends. Updated daily.
